_README: HOW TO ADD MORE REVIEWS — Google's API only ever returns 5 reviews, so the other 15 must be copied by hand from your Google Business Profile dashboard (Business Profile > Reviews) or the public Maps listing. Copy the reviewer's name and review text into a new object in the reviews array below and it appears automatically. No code change needed. Entries marked NEEDS_NAME are real reviews whose author Google did not return — fill those in and they start rendering.

_template._comment: Copy this shape for each new review, then delete this _template key.
_template.author: Name exactly as it appears on Google
